decision: Required to start the Race from the Pit Lane.
fact: The following Power Unit elements have been used: 4th Energy Store (ES) 4th Control Electronics Unit (PU-CE) 4th MGU-K All Power Unit elements were replaced without the approval of the FIA Technical Delegate during parc fermé. Furthermore, Car 87 was not covered two (2) hours after chequered flag of Q3.
offence: Breaches of Articles B8.2.2 (in conjunction with B8.2.3), B3.4.3a, B3.5.3 and B3.5.4 of the FIA F1 Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the Race from the Pit Lane.
reason: TGR Haas F1 Team changed the above Power Unit elements under Parc Fermé before the start of the Race, without the approval of the Technical Delegate. This is not in accordance with Article B3.5.4 of the FIA F1 Regulations. Car 87 is therefore required to start the Race from Pit Lane as per Article B3.5.3a of the FIA F1 Regulations. The change of Power Unit elements would normally require a grid drop penalty, but due to the fact that a pit lane start is already warranted by another infringement, issuing a grid drop is redundant.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 87 Pu Elements Changed During Parc Ferme
